ordered_rules.when: qualification is not validated against its exact retained input/provenance identity
forecast horizon is non-positive, non-finite, or inconsistent across retained targets
primary comparison is not the prespecified nested RelationalAugmented vs NonRelationalContext comparison
single-window qualification has fewer than 4 held-out target samples
rolling-origin qualification has fewer than 4 origins, or held-out target windows are not disjoint
measured loss-dependence profile is valid and the design remains within this fixed-horizon v1 scope
dependence characterization is missing/invalid, a second unregistered inferential method is requested, or a joint multi-horizon analysis is introduced
